description: Interchange contract for physics-derived receiver mechanical state. Produced by importers/ from solver exports (CSV/VTK). Consumed by SCYTHE's RF inference stack as an optional explanatory hypothesis, never as measurement.

boundary_condition_digest.description: SHA-256 over the boundary-condition / loading block.

deck_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the solver input deck (.rad / .k) that produced this record.

export_digest.description: SHA-256 of the raw solver export file (CSV/VTK) this record was derived from.

material_model_digest.description: SHA-256 over the material cards / material parameter block.

mesh_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the mesh file, if external to the deck.

solver_build.description: Release identifier of the solver binary used.

solver_commit.description: Full commit SHA of the solver source. Redundant with solver.commit by design: provenance must survive even if the solver block is stripped.

acceleration_mps2.description: Phase-center acceleration [ax, ay, az] in m/s^2.

antenna_normal.description: Antenna boresight unit vector. SHOULD be unit length; importers normalize.

enclosure_vibration_mps2.description: Enclosure acceleration [ax, ay, az] in m/s^2 — the quantity an accelerometer would corroborate.

mount_flex_m.description: Mount-point flex displacement [x, y, z] in metres, if the deck models the mount.

phase_center_displacement_m.description: Displacement of the phase center from its nominal (undeformed) position.

phase_center_m.description: Antenna phase-center position [x, y, z] in metres, simulation frame.

uncertainty.description: 1-sigma uncertainties on the above, same units. Simulation uncertainty is model-form + discretization, not sensor noise.

velocity_mps.description: Phase-center velocity [vx, vy, vz] in m/s. Feeds the f_d = v_r / lambda discriminator.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Importers must stamp exactly this.

simulation_time_s.description: Solver time at which this state snapshot was sampled.

build.description: Release/build identifier, e.g. 'OpenCourant_linux64.zip @ latest-20261006'. Informational; the commit SHA is the pin.

commit.description: Full commit SHA of the solver source. Tags may move; SHAs do not.

name.description: Solver instrument, e.g. 'OpenCourant' (community fork of OpenRadioss). Schema is solver-agnostic; modal solvers (CalculiX, Code_Aster) are legal here too.

state_class.description: LOAD-BEARING. This record is a physics-derived hypothesis from a solver. It is NEVER a measurement. The only other legal value in SCYTHE's state taxonomy is MEASURED_RECEIVER_STATE (instruments: GPS/IMU/accelerometer), which this schema MUST NOT emit.

title: SCYTHE Mechanical State v1
